index.description: An index expression that restricts which indices are considered. Defaults to `metrics-*`

match[].description: Repeated series selectors, for example `up{job="prometheus"}`; at least one is required

start.description: The start of the time range, as an RFC 3339 timestamp or Unix time in seconds. Defaults to 24 hours before `end`

end.description: The end of the time range, as an RFC 3339 timestamp or Unix time in seconds. Defaults to the current time

limit.description: The maximum number of series to return. `0` means no limit from the request
